errors.text_span: The categories are grouped into three layers
errors.evidence: The chart shows four main layers in the inner circle (Perception, Semantic, Cultural, Signal), not three.

errors.text_span: The Signal Layer includes Anomaly Detection, Acoustic Quality Analysis, Audio Difference Analysis, and Signal Layer.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly includes "Signal Layer" as a sub-category of itself. The chart shows the subcategories are Anomaly Detection, Acoustic Quality Analysis, and Audio Difference Analysis.

errors.text_span: The Cultural Layer comprises Imagination, Culture of Speaker, Asthetic Analysis, Professional Knowl & Reasoning, and Spatial Analysis.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns 'Asthetic Analysis' (which belongs to the Semantic Layer) and 'Spatial Analysis' (which belongs to the Perception Layer) to the Cultural Layer.
The description omits 'Spatial Analysis' from the list of subcategories for the Perception Layer.
The description omits 'Asthetic Analysis' from the list of subcategories for the Semantic Layer.
The chart does not have a legend; all labels are directly on the slices.

errors.text_span: percentage labels provided for the three layers
errors.evidence: Percentage labels are provided for all four layers (Signal, Cultural, Semantic, Perception), not just three.

errors.text_span: The segments are visually arranged in a descending order of size, with the Perception Layer occupying the largest area, followed by the Semantic Layer
errors.evidence: This is incorrect in two ways. First, the Semantic Layer (41.2%) is larger than the Perception Layer (40.4%). Second, the slices are not arranged in descending order of size around the circle.
